### How to Verify / Update the Roster

1. **Official Club Site** – The most reliable source is the club’s own website:  
   <https://www.manutd.com/en/players-and staff>  
   (Navigate to “First Team” under the “Players” tab.)

2. **Premier League Registration** – The Premier League publishes the official squad lists for each club at the start of every season.  
   <https://www.premierleague.com/clubs/16/Manchester-United/players>

3. **Transfer Window Updates** – During the summer and January transfer windows, the club’s roster can change. Keep an eye on official announcements or reputable sports news outlets (e.g., BBC Sport, Sky Sports, ESPN).
